summary: INT. VEIL MARKET — UPPER BALCONY — NIGHT. Worklights, signs and storefront spill flicker over crowded ration lines and route traffic.
settingText: INT. VEIL MARKET — UPPER BALCONY — NIGHT
panelPlan: Establish Veil Market at night from the upper balcony: ration lines, route chalk, practical worklights, signs and storefront spill, traders shouting over one another.
Jex crosses the balcony with a stack of manifests and two guards half a step behind.
The crowd below is busy and noisy enough that the assassin can get close without visually telegraphing the attack in advance.
directionInline: Keep the Market vivid because it is working infrastructure under pressure, not because it has invented rituals. No lantern imagery; light comes from ordinary market, maintenance and commercial sources.

summary: Jex survives the season's real assassination attempt and realizes the attack was meant to remove a functioning broker, not merely punish him.
settingText: INT. VEIL MARKET — BROKER VAULT — NIGHT
panelPlan: Establish INT. VEIL MARKET — BROKER VAULT — NIGHT. The knife attack is sudden and ugly.
Naomi knocks the assassin's arm away but Jex still goes down bleeding. Dialogue beat with Naomi, Jex: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
Halev crouches beside him while market guards chase the attacker. Dialogue beat with Halev, Jex: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
Jex notices a dropped payment chit under the railing and focuses on it before his own wound. Dialogue beat with Naomi, Jex: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
Final consequence/reaction beat. Naomi has to reach for it while keeping pressure on his side.

dialogueInline.speaker: Halev
dialogueInline.text: Can you see who did it?

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: No. But I can see who paid.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jex
dialogueInline.text: Seal on the chit. Get it before somebody steps on it.

summary: INT. VEIL MARKET — BROKER VAULT — NIGHT. Outside, chants rise—half rage, half fear.
settingText: INT. VEIL MARKET — BROKER VAULT — NIGHT
panelPlan: Establish INT. VEIL MARKET — BROKER VAULT — NIGHT. In the broker vault, Jex is being stitched up while the market outside surges between anger and panic.
Naomi places the recovered payment chit beside Jex's own transaction reader.
Final consequence/reaction beat. The evidence is physically present before anyone interprets it.

summary: INT. THUNDERBREAK — COMMAND — NIGHT. VENN watches riot feeds flicker on holos.
panelPlan: Establish INT. THUNDERBREAK — COMMAND — NIGHT. Thunderbreak receives overlapping riot feeds and a request for Fleet intervention.
An officer begins plotting a frigate route directly into the market. Dialogue beat with Officer, Venn: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
Venn deletes the weapons path but approves medical teams at exterior exits. Dialogue beat with Officer, Venn: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
Selene notes the request and response without commenting on Venn's morality. Dialogue beat with Selene: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.

dialogueInline.text: Send med teams to the exits. No guns in that crowd.

summary: INT. THUNDERBREAK — COMMAND — NIGHT. Venn doesn’t reply.
panelPlan: Establish INT. THUNDERBREAK — COMMAND — NIGHT. Venn watches one med shuttle peel away from the armed formation and head toward the market edge.
She looks at the riot feed, then at the weapons-ready frigates she is holding back.
Final consequence/reaction beat. No reply to Selene; the conflict is visible in what stays parked.

summary: Jex sacrifices profit to stop hunger from becoming the assassin's second weapon.
settingText: INT. VEIL MARKET — LOWER CAVERNS — NIGHT
panelPlan: Establish INT. VEIL MARKET — LOWER CAVERNS — NIGHT. The crowd is pounding on the reserve shutters while smoke moves through the hall.
Halev tries to keep people from lighting the storage area on fire. Dialogue beat with Halev, Jex: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
Jex, pale from the stabbing, reaches the control station and orders every reserve opened. Dialogue beat with Clerk, Jex: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
A clerk asks twice because the financial decision is so unlike him. Dialogue beat with Clerk, Jex: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
The shutters rise and actual food interrupts the riot. Dialogue beat with Naomi: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
Final consequence/reaction beat. The shutters rise and actual food interrupts the riot.

dialogueInline.text: If this hall burns, the food burns with it!

summary: Naomi keeps Jex alive long enough for him to connect the assassin's payment to the engineered shortage.
settingText: INT. VEIL MARKET — BACK ALLEY — NIGHT
panelPlan: Establish INT. VEIL MARKET — BACK ALLEY — NIGHT. Naomi helps Jex through a back corridor while checking the payment chit against market records on her wrist display.
Jex is leaning more heavily on her than he wants to admit. Dialogue beat with Naomi, Jex: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
She has already run the comparison before he asks. Dialogue beat with Naomi, Jex: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
His final reaction is small because the implication is large. Dialogue beat with Naomi, Jex: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
Final consequence/reaction beat. His final reaction is small because the implication is large.

dialogueInline.text: You are a terrible person to keep alive.

summary: INT. VEIL MARKET — BACK ALLEY — NIGHT. They push back into the hall.
settingText: INT. VEIL MARKET — BACK ALLEY — NIGHT

Final consequence/reaction beat. Jex sees both outcomes at once.

Final consequence/reaction beat. He picks it up with the other hand.

summary: Jex proves the shortage, riot money and assassination payment came through the same network, creating evidence that can outlive him.
settingText: INT. VEIL MARKET — MAIN CAVERN — DAWN
panelPlan: Establish INT. VEIL MARKET — MAIN CAVERN — DAWN. Jex and Naomi spread three transaction chains across a scorched counter and collapse them into the same shell-account tree.
Jex realizes the pattern by physically lining up the records. Dialogue beat with Jex, Naomi: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.

Naomi begins transmitting copies to Halev, Venn, Selene and public market nodes before he finishes telling her to. Dialogue beat with Jex, Naomi: preserve exact line order and visible listening/reaction.
